column1: # The Book's inventory (feature root-e2e): one row per code block of docs/book/content.html and, from the
# claims task on, one per sentence that states a value or an outcome. Tab-separated, one row per line:
#   kind  id  fingerprint  verdict  covered_by  gap  text
# kind: block | claim. id: <chapter>#<n> (n counts the chapter's `<pre data-lang>` blocks from 1) or
# <chapter>~<8 hex digits of the sentence's fingerprint>. fingerprint: FNV-1a 64 of the decoded text.
# verdict: run refused fragment held shown holds diverges unraised disputed binary prose pending.
# covered_by: <crate>/<target>::<fn> (`piperine` is the root package), a block id for a fragment, `-` for none.
# gap: the GAPS.md id of a row the binary does not meet, `-` for none. text: the listing's command, `-` for none.
# tests/book/inventory_guard.rs holds the rows to the Book: a Book edit that adds, moves or changes a block
# fails it and prints the corrected row.

piperine run clipper.msl --analysis transient --stop 2e-3 --print vin --print vout --stream clip --plot clipper.svg
piperine run cycles.msl --analysis transient --stop 3e-3 --print-step 1e-3 --print count --stream pulse
piperine run buck.msl --analysis transient --stop 12e-3 --print vout --print-step 1e-3 --stream loop
piperine run lowpass.msl --analysis op --reltol 1e-9 --vntol 1e-12 --nodeset vout=5 --print vout
piperine run lowpass.msl --analysis tf --input v1 --output vout
